releases.name: OpenWork v0.18.67
releases.body:
## AI Gateway capabilities are now available to every organization

- **More AI Gateway features are available to every organization.** Auth & Security, config import and export, AI Gateway API keys for other tools, custom OpenAI-compatible providers, and Smart Routers are now available to every organization, including self-hosted deployments; their completed-rollout switches are gone. TrueFoundry is also available directly in the provider picker. Organizations that had not enabled Auth & Security now have 30-day session limits and admins confirm their identity after 15 minutes for sensitive changes. Claude prompt caching also lowers the cost of long sessions through AI Gateway.
- **Admins have clearer controls for roles and computers.** Admins can assign built-in or custom roles to people or teams, and members can disconnect signed-in computers and set what other devices may do on each one. New sandbox organizations make joiners super admins by default. The My Sessions pages have been removed from Den, and a member's Workbot cloud computers are deleted when they leave an organization.
- **Workbot and remote tasks recover more cleanly.** Workbot can hand over apps as cards, recovered tasks no longer show as failed, and remote tasks can bring questions and computer-use approvals back to the chat that started them. Unresponsive cloud computers can be replaced, and idle ones pause again.
- **Desktop chats and setup are more dependable.** File actions find files inside project subfolders, OpenCode v2 web search cards show their results, OpenWork Models no longer appear missing from the model catalog, and remotely launched chats keep their model choice. Claude Code sign-in can continue in your browser, and desktop Automations run with models that have no variant.
- **Workbot Documents can play audio and video.** Admins no longer configure a Workbot step limit or separate mail and chat sources; access follows the Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, or Slack connector they allow. OpenWork-built interactive views are now called Artifacts throughout chat, the library, and sharing.
- **Website visitors and admins have new setup guidance.** The website adds an EU sovereignty guide and checklist, and the docs add a knowledge-work cost benchmark and an OIDC sign-in guide. Connector setup also shows the callback URL needed by OAuth providers.

Full changelog: https://openworklabs.com/docs/changelog · [Compare](https://github.com/different-ai/openwork/compare/v0.18.66...v0.18.67)

*Windows installers are signed using Microsoft Artifact Signing.*

releases.name: OpenWork v0.18.66
releases.body:
## What's new

OpenWork v0.18.66 desktop release.

- Public artifacts use the openwork-* naming convention.
- Cloud artifacts use openwork-cloud-* and require sign-in without enterprise activation.
- Enterprise artifacts use openwork-enterprise-* while retaining the standard OpenWork app identity.
- Public, Cloud, and enterprise Electron builds use separate updater manifests on this release.

*Windows installers are signed using Microsoft Artifact Signing.*

releases.name: OpenWork v0.18.63
releases.body:
## Bring Claude conversations into OpenWork

- **Bring your Claude history with you.** Import Claude chats and Claude Code sessions into a workspace from Settings → Import, where they become regular OpenWork chats.
- **Work with connected files on OpenCode v2.** Bring Google Drive, OneDrive, and SharePoint files into your workspace and save edits back; attach workspace files to Gmail drafts and replies, or upload them to Google Drive. OpenWork asks you to approve each transfer.
- **Use computer use on Windows and set it up once.** Windows desktop users can use computer use with apps on This PC. Set it up in Settings → Computer use; chats no longer have a computer status button, and the browser has one button in the side rail.
- **Desktop work keeps its place and gets easier to start.** The window reopens at its previous size and position, Cmd+N (Ctrl+N) starts a session even while you type, and organization switching refreshes your skills, connected apps, and models. Verified sign-in no longer waits for organization discovery to finish. Show model reasoning now starts off; turn it on in Settings → Preferences to see readable reasoning.
- **For admins: completed features are now available by default, with clearer controls.** Local AI providers, Automation settings, agent-assisted connection removal, Workbot search, improved usage-limit cards, task-preserving sign-in, Claude imports, and organization Prompts are available without a special setup; retired OpenCode Zen models are no longer offered. Automations are on by default, with separate Desktop and Cloud controls for organizations; sandbox join links add admins by default, with a choice to add members instead.
- **Workbot, models, and self-hosted setups are more dependable.** Workbot handles brief sign-in interruptions and rebuilds outdated computers when resumed. OpenWork Models adds GPT-6.1 Terra, Kimi K3.1 Pro, and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash; self-hosted desktops no longer update beyond the server's supported release.

Full changelog: https://openworklabs.com/docs/changelog · [Compare](https://github.com/different-ai/openwork/compare/v0.18.62...v0.18.63)
